# Simple Soccer Scorer

> A free sideline scoring and match timer app for grassroots football (soccer) coaches. All match data is stored locally on the device — no accounts, no servers.

Simple Soccer Scorer helps coaches track scores, goal scorers, assists, and match timings on the sideline. It supports halves or quarters, overtime, and a lock-screen mode for pocket-safe operation. The app works offline and is available on the web, Apple App Store, and Google Play.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with app features and store download links.
- [Try the app](/app): Launch the live scoreboard and start a new match in the browser.
- [Match History](/history): Review and edit previously saved matches.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How the app handles data — all storage is local to the device.
- [Terms of Use](/terms): Terms governing use of the app.
